commits.author: StanGirard
commits.subject: feat(agent): use bash init script instead of tmux send-keys injection
commits.body:
Replace the hacky tmux send-keys injection mechanism with a cleaner
bash init script approach for terminal session initialization.

Changes:
- Add lib/init-script.ts for generating bash init scripts
- Spawn tmux with `bash --init-file /tmp/247-init-{session}.sh`
- Script exports env vars, configures tmux, then runs `exec bash -i`
- Auto-cleanup of init script after 5 seconds
- Proper escaping of special characters in env var values

Benefits:
- No more race conditions (no 100ms delay)
- No visible commands to erase with ANSI sequences
- Simpler, more maintainable code
- Deterministic initialization

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: docs: add git worktree workflow instructions to CLAUDE.md
commits.body:
Explain that development happens in session worktrees and that
releases must be done from the main worktree.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.diff:
diff --git a/CLAUDE.md b/CLAUDE.md
index bb0d4e3..cc81393 100644
--- a/CLAUDE.md
+++ b/CLAUDE.md
@@ -99,6 +99,34 @@ The `pnpm release` command automates semantic versioning based on conventional c
 - **Always run tests** - Run `pnpm test` before committing any changes. All tests must pass.
 - **Always add relevant tests** - When adding or modifying features, write corresponding unit/integration tests. No code change without appropriate test coverage.
 
+## Git Worktree Workflow
+
+**IMPORTANT:** Ce projet utilise des git worktrees pour isoler les sessions de développement.
+
+- **Worktree principal (main):** `/Users/stan/Dev/BrainStorming`
+- **Worktrees de session:** `/tmp/247-workspaces/<session-name>` (ex: `BrainStorming--cool-bear-5`)
+
+### Règles de workflow
+
+1. **Développement:** Se fait dans le worktree de session (branche `session/<session-name>`)
+2. **Commits:** Peuvent être faits dans le worktree de session
+3. **Push de la branche:** Peut être fait depuis le worktree de session
+4. **Merge sur main:** Utiliser `git push origin <branch>:main` depuis le worktree de session
+5. **Release:** **DOIT être fait depuis le worktree principal** (`/Users/stan/Dev/BrainStorming/claude-remote-control`)
+
+### Commandes pour release
+
+```bash
+# Depuis le worktree de session, après avoir pushé sur main:
+cd /Users/stan/Dev/BrainStorming/claude-remote-control && git pull origin main && pnpm release
+```
+
+### Pourquoi ?
+
+- Le script de release vérifie qu'on est sur la branche `main`
+- La branche `main` est "locked" par le worktree principal
+- On ne peut pas checkout `main` depuis un worktree de session
+
 ## Testing Rules
 
 - **Always add tests for new code** - Every new feature, function, or component must have corresponding tests

commits.subject: fix(web): fix mobile Start Session button not responding (#6)
commits.body:
The "Start Session" button in NewSessionModal was not responding to
taps on mobile when a session was already open. This was caused by
touch event propagation issues.

Changes:
- Move click handler from outer container to backdrop div directly
- Remove unnecessary stopPropagation from modal content
- Add touch-manipulation class to button for faster touch response
- Increase modal z-index to z-[60] to ensure it's above MobileStatusStrip

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: feat(planning): implement planning session with Claude (#8)
commits.body:
- Add planning prompt generator that instructs Claude to:
  - Investigate codebase
  - Ask clarifying questions
  - Create issues via curl API calls
  - Update project status when done

- Add /start-planning endpoint to managed projects route
- Pass planningProjectId through terminal connection chain
- Generate init script that starts Claude with planning prompt
- Parse planningProjectId from URL params for session creation

- Add comprehensive tests for planning functionality:
  - planning-prompt.test.ts: Tests for prompt generator
  - planning-session-url.test.ts: Tests for URL parameter handling
  - init-script.test.ts: Tests for planning prompt in init script

This enables a simpler planning workflow where:
1. User creates project with "Plan with Claude" mode
2. Terminal session launches with Claude pre-loaded with planning prompt
3. User interacts with Claude to plan the project
4. Claude creates issues via API and updates project status

commits.subject: feat(web): make git worktree optional when creating sessions (#9)
commits.body:
Previously, worktree creation was forced (hardcoded worktree=true) for all
new sessions. This change makes worktree creation optional with a toggle
in the NewSessionModal, defaulting to OFF.

Changes:
- Add useWorktree to SelectedSession interface
- Update handleStartSession to accept optional useWorktree parameter
- Add worktree toggle UI in SelectFolderTab using ToggleSwitch component
- Only add worktree=true URL param when toggle is enabled
- Add tests for worktree URL parameter behavior

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
